android.releaseNotes:
• E2EE Message Decryption on App Restart: Fixed critical issue where historical chat messages became unreadable Base64 ciphertext on app restart; added sender RSA encryption keys and hardened ratchet session caching.
• Native Notification Decryption: Resolved issue where push notifications displayed generic "New message" instead of decrypted content; converted DM pushes to high-priority data payloads and restored E2EE metadata in notifications table.
• Modern Storage Permissions: Fixed "Storage permission denied" on Android 13+ by eliminating legacy storage permission checks on SAF document & photo pickers.
